package cm;
@NiagaraProperty(name="a", type="BStatusNumeric", defaultValue="http://x", flags=Flags.OPERATOR)
@NiagaraProperty(name="b", type="BStatusNumeric", defaultValue="/*", flags=Flags.OPERATOR)
@NiagaraProperty(name="c", type="BStatusNumeric", flags=Flags.OPERATOR)
@NiagaraProperty(name="d", type="BStatusNumeric", defaultValue="*/", flags=Flags.OPERATOR)
@NiagaraProperty(name="e", type="BStatusNumeric", flags=Flags.OPERATOR)
@NiagaraAction(name="go", defaultValue="BString.make(\"//\")")
@NiagaraAction(name="setE")
public class BL extends BComponent
{
  public void doGo() { String s = "{"; setE(1); }
}
